rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 329 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (elections_public_opinion led 11-23, geopolitics led 11-24, so policy_regulation leads today, then elections_public_opinion, then geopolitics); within each group the list starts at offset 329 % group_size in pool order (policy 329 % 15 = 14: 개인정보 AI first; elections 329 % 9 = 5: political bot network first; geopolitics 329 % 10 = 9: 소버린 AI first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds and agency press pages (whitehouse.gov, bis.gov, federalregister.gov, justice.gov, ftc.gov, korea.kr, pipc.go.kr, msit.go.kr, digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-24, so items published 11-24 (after the prior harvest) through 11-25 are in scope. Context: Wednesday 11-25 in Korea / Tuesday 11-24 in the US and EU at harvest time. Thanksgiving is Thursday 11-26 — US agencies, the White House and state AGs tend to push releases and filings Tuesday-Wednesday before the holiday; Federal Register public-inspection lists for 11-25/11-27 are worth scanning. EU: Commission college meets Wednesdays; Parliament committees (IMCO/LIBE/JURI) and Council working parties active on the digital omnibus / AI Act delay. Korea: 국회 정기회 막바지 — 과방위·법사위 법안소위, 예결위 예산안 심사(법정 처리기한 12-2); 국무회의는 화요일(11-24) 결과 확인. Taiwan local elections are Saturday 11-28: in the final days, NEW CEC/MJIB/MODA/NSB official counts, indictments or takedown orders on AI deepfakes are high-value; previously covered counts/cases (Puma Shen indictment 11-22, ~2,700 Threads accounts 11-21, CIB 219 cases 11-13) do not qualify. Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: Nvidia California AG subpoena (Huang testimony Dec 1 — skip previews); Grok/SpaceX state suits (covered 11-24 — only another state joining, a TRO/court order, or SpaceX's formal response is new); BIS Megaspeed entity listing (covered 11-24 from public inspection — the 11-25 Federal Register publication is the SAME rule, a duplicate); Hochul veto of AI accuracy-warning bill (covered 11-24); Trump offshore data-center tax (only an EO/Treasury action/bill text is new). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis, commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
